title: A Great App
body: The first time I came across this app was years ago, I think in 2021. I struggled at first to remain consistent but looking back now, this app remained me that I’ve been craving long term change for a while now. The difference between me in 2021 and me in 2026 now is that now I truly believe in myself and my abilities. Then I had a lot of doubts and was unable to follow through. Now I’m older, wiser, more determined and disciplined. This app is such a great way to start if you’re like me, looking for long term positive change.

title: WISH MEETS OPPORTUNITY
body:
I have tried many times to imbibe the culture of regular exercise, drinking water first thing in the morning regular reading especially in the morning and a host of other healthy and productive habits. 
Each time I tried, I wouldn’t go far before I would stop. I was even afraid that that was becoming an habit of its own.
I met Fabulous accidentally, and I felt since then that I was lucky, perhaps because a wish met the right opportunity at right time.
Fabulous methodology is fantastic, there’s no better adjective than fabulous because it is crafted not only to be pleasant, but also surprisingly successful!
How: easy small starts, wonderful encouragement, reasonable early warnings of possible discouraging events which it (fabulous) rightly calls “demons”, gradual build-ups, the aspect of reward & celebrations of even small achievement ete etc are all wonderful and effective.
I am looking forward to reaching the zenith of the Fabulous project for a better Aliu.
Most grateful.
